text: The south side of Dewbourne Avenue east of Bathurst Street had the stretch of curb with No Parking at all times extended eastward in September 2017. This was passed due to safety concerns for residents trying to exit their drives when Bathurst Street vehicles arriving onto Dewbourne Avenue, were pushed into the incorrect lane to avoid parked vehicles. Since then, vehicles with handicap permits have parked regularly in the location. This stretch of No Parking needs to become No Stopping to better address the original safety concern.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Reopened Item TE26.120 - Dewbourne Avenue, Request to Extend No Parking By-law. 2. Deleted Recommendation 2 and replaced it with the following new Recommendation: "2. Prohibit stopping at all times on the south side of Dewbourne Avenue, between Bathurst Street and a point 24.8 metres east.”
